pages.text: A beam where you look, up to $(bold)16 blocks$(). $(bold)50 W$().

pages.title: Fitting
pages.text: Put it in the $(bold)Helmet Mount$() slot. It works only under an $(l:orsa_equipment/eva_suit)EVA Helmet$(/l) or Thermal Visor.$(br2)Goggles keep their own slot.

pages.title: Power
pages.text: It draws from loose Power Cells: hotbar and inventory first, then offhand. Not from a lantern's cell.$(br2)Without a cell it pauses and stays switched on.

pages.title: Switch
pages.text: Press $(bold)H$() (Toggle Headlamp) to switch it. It's crafted off.$(br2)A full cell runs it about 2 h 47 min.
Iron, glass, copper and redstone. The cell is separate.
